messages:
katie: FYI customer ticket #98721 — sudden p95/p99 jump on text-gen since last night, they're seeing ~3x p99 on long-context requests. raising here to triage.

support-bot: Ticket 98721 linked: https://support.example/98721 — customer: AcmeRetail. Reported ~00:45 UTC.

anil: thanks. any rollouts around that time?
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-17T00:40Z rolled runtime v1.12.3 with flash-attn compileflag enabled (env: FLASH_ATTEN_OPT=1) (reaction :eyes:)

sophie: I can repro locally with the model and long-seqs (>2048). p95 jumps when FlashAttention path selected. repro script:
```
python repro.py --model redwood/txl-13b --seq 4096 --batch 1 --prompt long
```
latency: baseline 220ms -> 780ms after flag

ben: interesting — core dump shows frequent kernel fallback to SDPA with many small kernels. logs:
```
WARN kernel_select: incompatible_tiling -> fallback to SDPA
metrics: kernel_migration_count=4123
```

anil: so it's not pure flash bug, it's kernel_selection oscillation. probably heuristics misclassifying long-seq shapes. can we add a temporary opt to force stable kernel selection? i propose an env var FORCE_KERNEL=sdpa or FORCE_KERNEL=flash

sophie: we have that, but it's per-runtime. can we hotpatch config and roll canary? I can push a config patch to disable FLASH_ATTEN_OPT for the fleet.

katie: customer is sensitive, request ETA for mitigation and a rollback option. Also need a short postmortem template for them.

anil: quick mitigation: toggle compileflag off -> roll back v1.12.3 -> expected to restore p95 within minutes. downside: lose perf improvements for short seqs. want me to start rollback canary?

katie: yes start canary. tell support to inform customer. assign ANIL as owner.

sophie: starting canary now. patch 0f4c -> disabling FLASH_ATTEN_OPT. rolling to 5% -> 20% -> 100% if stable. monitoring p95.

(10min)
sophie: canary at 20% looks good: p95 down from 1.2s -> 260ms for the canary nodes. pushing to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to prod at 3925014200; new env FLASH_ATTEN_OPT=0

anil: confirm metrics back to normal on customer trace. will leave the flag off and open follow-up ticket to rework kernel heuristics.

katie: thanks all. follow-ups: - support to update customer and close ticket if OK - eng-runtime to add regression test for long seqs w/ both kernels - perf team to analyze patch and propose heuristic fix

ben: filing follow-up infra/kernel-heuristics-453 with repro and logs.

support-bot: Customer notified: "we rolled back a recent runtime flag and are monitoring; please reopen if you still see issues." (reaction :thumbsup:)

katie: closing here once support confirms customer ok. thanks :heart:
